'''Communication Intelligence''', abbreviated as '''ComInt''', was a division of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] during the time of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. Its [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were assigned to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to intercept enemy communications and deceiver them.
